edition.author: William Hersey Davis
edition.title: Beginner's Grammar of the Greek New Testament

independence_note: Converter uses stdlib XML, independent oracle uses lxml and separately inventories scandata, tar, PDF and OCR against actual TEI. Shared DjVuXML recognition cannot prove print-level wording. Heading recognition uses a source-text rule in both implementations; source-located visual anchors are required for semantic confidence.
known_limitations: Uncorrected OCR has severe Greek recognition errors.
Eleven access pages have no OCR word tokens; image-only text remains untranscribed.
Paradigms are retained as alternate Abbyy OCR tables, but Greek cell readings and their attachment to DjVu paragraphs are not print-verified; vocabulary and index entries retain source line carriers.
The contents page-level hierarchy is preserved, but four-page entry and column alignment cannot be reliably recovered from DjVu OCR.
Full image-to-TEI collation and human acceptance remain open.
1923 U.S. print public-domain basis does not clear IA digitization or OCR rights.

mapping_policy.exclusions: Disposition original leaves 0, 281, 282 and 283 as outside the access PDF/OCR sequence; retain their JP2 identities and do not infer missing literary text.
mapping_policy.groups: Source-observed boundaries: preliminaries, four contents pages, Part I divider and lessons, Part II supplement, English index, vocabularies, and end material. The contents retains OCR paragraph carriers because OCR interleaves columns and combines/splits some rows; full entry hierarchy is unresolved.
mapping_policy.pages: Represent each access leaf with a scan-page div, pb facsimile target, source paragraph and line order, and its original JP2 member in accounting.
mapping_policy.primary: Original JP2 image tar is the print witness. Page labels and access selection come from scandata; the PDF is a presentation derivative. DjVuXML supplies uncorrected OCR text, not print authority.
mapping_policy.support: Bind all retained acquisition members; member-inventory.tsv explicitly dispositions the 28 provider files.
mapping_policy.tables: All 89 Abbyy Table blocks on 75 original leaves are represented as row/cell tables in explicitly labeled alternate OCR layout witnesses. This duplicates portions of the primary DjVu reading by design; it does not claim the two OCR texts agree or reproduce the printed Greek.
mapping_policy.text: Preserve each OCR WORD string in its source LINE order, including uncertain Greek. Keep empty paragraphs and lines; signal zero-word pages with a gap. Do not silently substitute Abbyy or PDF OCR.
